# Set up

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")
source("../fun_mod/fun_ampphi.R")
library(ggridges)
library(tidybayes)
library(ggrepel)
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read in data
```{r}
# Read best waic
waiccomb_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waiccombbest.rds"))
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waicbest.rds"))
waic_best_all <- bind_rows(waic_best, waiccomb_best)
```

# Read in coefficients of the observed data 
```{r}
all_samplescosine <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescosine.rds")) %>%
  filter(mod %in% waic_best_all$mod_best)
```

# Check convergence (Rhats) of the models ==========================================================

```{r}
# Check that Rhats == 1
sim_rhats <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$simpredres}/simpred_rhats.rds"), dir = "", {
  list.files(glue("{dirs$simpred_rhats}"), full.names = TRUE) %>%
    lapply(readRDS) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    group_by(mod) %>%
    filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
    mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1),
           Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
    select(mod, Rhat_cond)
})
filter(sim_rhats, Rhat_cond == FALSE)
```

# Read the coefficients and obtain amp and phi =====================================================

```{r}
# Select only converging models 
df_converged <- filter(sim_rhats, Rhat_cond == TRUE)

# Read in the coefficients
sim_coef <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$simpredres}/simpred_coef.rds"), dir = "", {
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    # Read in the coeficients 
    coef <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$simpred_coef}/coef_{x}"))
    # Obtain fixed coefficients
    fe <- coef$fixed[ , "Estimate"] 
    names(fe) <- row.names(coef$fixed)
    # Define region 
    reg <- str_extract(x, "reg_2|reg_3|reg_4|reg_6")
    clu_ref <- ifelse(reg == "reg_2", "1_North", "1_Temperate")
    clu <- c(clu_ref, str_subset(names(fe), "clu") %>%
               str_extract(str_c(tidy_names_clu$clu[!is.na(tidy_names_clu$clu)], collapse = "|")) %>%
               unique())
    # Reassemble intercept, cos, sin, and shape for every region and cluster
    region_coefs <- data.frame(
      reg = reg, 
      clu = clu,
      shape = coef$spec_pars["shape","Estimate"]) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        int = fe["Intercept"] + 
          ifelse((is.na(clu) | str_detect(clu, "1_")), 0, fe[paste0("clu", clu)]),
        p_cos = fe["cospi_vac_week_v1"] + 
          ifelse((is.na(clu) | str_detect(clu, "1_")), 0, fe[paste0("clu", clu, ":cospi_vac_week_v1")]),
        p_sin = fe["sinpi_vac_week_v1"] + 
          ifelse((is.na(clu) | str_detect(clu, "1_")), 0, fe[paste0("sinpi_vac_week_v1:clu", clu)])
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      # Obtain amplitude and phase
      mutate(
        amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
        phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
        amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
        mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) 
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(pat = str_extract(mod, "(?<=s08_).*?(?=_cs)"),
           sim = str_extract(mod, "(?<=simpred_).*?(?=_bmv)"),
           type = "sim") %>%
    select(sim, pat, clu, mod, everything())
})
```

# Combine data and simulations coefficients ========================================================
```{r}
# Read in all the samples
tog_coef <- all_samplescosine %>%
  mutate(type = "true", sim = "true") %>%
  select(sim, type,  pat, clu, mod, reg, int_mean, p_cos_mean, p_sin_mean, amp_ls_mean, phi_mean, amp_mean, mu_ns_mean,
         ends_with("ci95up"), ends_with("ci95lo")) %>%
  # Get only means and CI
  distinct() %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("_mean", "", .x)) %>%
  rename_with(~gsub("sam_", "", .x)) %>%
  bind_rows(select(sim_coef, -shape)) %>%
  mutate(mod = sub("^modsimpred_\\d+_", "", mod))
```

# Check bias =======================================================================================

## Calculate bias
```{r}
bias_df <- tog_coef %>%
  left_join(waic_best_all %>%
              rename(mod = mod_best) %>%
              distinct(mod, dat),  
    by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  select(sim, type, pat, clu, mod, dat, reg, phi, amp) %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod, "multi", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(pat, clu, mod, reg) %>%
  # Obtain true values
  mutate(
    phi_true = phi[sim == "true"],
    amp_true = amp[sim == "true"]) %>%
  filter(type == "sim") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  # Obtain absolute bias
  mutate(
    amp_bias = abs(amp - amp_true),
    phi_bias = case_when(
      phi >= phi_true ~ min(abs(phi_true - phi), abs((52-phi) + phi_true)),
      phi < phi_true ~ min(abs(phi_true - phi), abs((52-phi_true) + phi)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pat, clu, mod, reg) %>%
  # Obtain mean absolute bias
  mutate(
    mean_amp_bias = mean(amp_bias),
    mean_phi_bias = mean(phi_bias),
    mean_amp_bias_75lo = quantile(amp_bias, 0.125),
    mean_amp_bias_75up = quantile(amp_bias, 0.875),
    mean_phi_bias_75lo = quantile(phi_bias, 0.125),
    mean_phi_bias_75up = quantile(phi_bias, 0.875),
    ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Define selection criteria ========================================================================
```{r}
biassumm_df <- bias_df %>%
  distinct(type, pat, clu, mod, dat, reg, mean_amp_bias, mean_phi_bias, 
           mean_amp_bias_75lo, mean_amp_bias_75up, mean_phi_bias_75lo, mean_phi_bias_75up) %>%
  mutate(included = !(mean_amp_bias > 0.20 | mean_phi_bias > 9))
```

# Save selection criteria 
```{r}
all_datagapssim <- biassumm_df %>%
  distinct(pat, clu, mod, dat, reg, included)

saveRDS(all_datagapssim, glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagapssim.rds"))
```

# Supplementary figure 03 ==========================================================================
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "rubel","ipv1", "hib", "strep04",
             "pertuwpt", "hav", "dipht", "mumps", "menc", "tetan", "hbv")

pldf_bias <- biassumm_df %>%
  #filter(filter(waic_best))
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu)) %>%
  mutate(
    included_tidy = if_else(included, "Included", "Excluded"),
    dat = case_when(
      dat == "s08" & pat %in% pat_sel & mod %in% waic_best$mod_best ~ "Main analyses",
      dat == "semeth_s08" ~ "Sensitivity analyses: \nSerological methods",
      dat == "seallsero_s08" ~ "Sensitivity analyses: \nAll serological data rotavirus",
      .default = "Sensitivity analyses: \nAdditional antigenic measurements"
      ))


supfig3 <- filter(pldf_bias, included_tidy == "Included") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_phi_bias, y = mean_amp_bias)) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.20), color = "grey") + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 9), color = "grey") + 
  geom_point(aes(x = mean_phi_bias, y = mean_amp_bias), color = "orange") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(pldf_bias, included_tidy == "Excluded"), color = "grey20") + 
  geom_label_repel(data = filter(pldf_bias, included_tidy == "Excluded"),
                   aes(label = paste0(pat_tidy, ": ", clu_tidy)), 
                   max.overlaps = Inf, 
                   nudge_x = 8, nudge_y = 0.05, 
                   size = 3, 
                   label.size = 0.1, 
                   force = 10,
                   direction = "y", hjust = "middle", vjust = "middle",
                   key_glyph="point") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Peak timing mean absolute bias", limits = c(0,25)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Amplitude mean absolute bias", limits = c(0,1)) + 
  guides(label = "none") + 
  facet_wrap(~dat, ncol = 2, scales = "free")

supfig3

# Save the plot
ggsave(glue("../{dirs$figures}/figsup3.pdf"), supfig3, width = 14, height = 13)
```
